title: 第三章炼丹房第四章引气入体
slug: 凡人修仙我能变废为宝
lines: 有那么一瞬间，江离生了告发金管事的念头，但这个念头很快就被他压了下去。
他不知道，要是被仙人老爷知道此事之后，会有什么后果。
别弄巧成拙，反而害死了自己。
金管事似乎也怕事情败露，急忙道：“上次发放黄庭丹，小的没舍得吃，留到了现在，与新发放的黄庭丹一并服用了。”
仙人老爷显然不相信他这番解释，环顾众杂役弟子：“有谁知道金管事多出来的那枚黄庭丹从何而来？”
全场鸦雀无声，无一人接话。
仙人老爷眉头微微皱起，再次开口：“我再问一遍，有谁知道金管事多出来的黄庭丹从何而来？”
不知是不是错觉，江离总感觉仙人老爷的目光有意无意的落在了他的附近，让他忍不住抬头。
却看到金管事的目光也落在了他的身上，看的江离心中一凛。
急忙将自己的脑袋低下，假装什么事也没有发生。
此事，绝对不能说出来。
等待片刻，仙人老爷没有得到自己想要的答案，这才冷哼一声：“记住！黄庭丹每三天最多服用一枚，否则就会像他一样，气窍异常扩张，血流不止。”
“把他抬回去，七日之后便会痊愈。这次也算是给你个教训。”
说完，仙人老爷一跃上了鹤身，飞向偏独峰。
仙人老爷走后，众杂役弟子才放松了下来。
有人将金管事重新抬回了房间，其余杂役弟子也回到了自己的屋子。
江离刚回到自己的屋子，门外便传来了敲门声。
开门一看，是一名平时和金管事较为亲近的杂役弟子。
那名杂役弟子上下打量了一遍江离，这才开口道：“金管事有事找你，你过去一趟。”
江离只得再次出门，来到金管事的房间。
刚一进入金管事的房间，江离就闻到了一股浓烈的血腥味。
金管事身上缠满了绷带，但鲜血依旧不断的从绷带中渗出，看着有些恐怖。
看到金管事霸占自己的黄庭丹，落得一个这样的下场，也是忍不住心中窃喜。
活该，真是活该。
这感觉……爽！
心中虽是觉得金管事罪有应得，表面上却不敢有丝毫显露。
对金管事行了一礼，问道：“金管事喊小的来是有什么事吩咐？”
金管事哀嚎着缓了半天，这才有力气说道：“这两日辛苦你了。以后砍柴的活不用你去做了，我会安排其他人去做。你收拾收拾，明天去炼丹房报道，负责打扫炼丹房。”
“炼丹房？”
江离一愣。
content_en:
For a moment, Jiang Li had the idea of ​​reporting on Manager Jin, but he quickly suppressed the idea.
He didn't know what the consequences would be if Master Immortal knew about this.
Don't make it self-defeating and kill yourself instead.
Manager Jin seemed to be afraid that the matter would be exposed, and said hurriedly: "The last time we distributed Huang Ting Dan, the little one was reluctant to eat it, so he kept it until now and took it together with the newly distributed Huang Ting Dan."
Master Immortal obviously didn't believe his explanation and looked around at the servant disciples: "Does anyone know where the extra Huang Ting Dan that Manager Jin got came from?"
The whole place was silent and no one answered.
Master Xianren frowned slightly and spoke again: "Let me ask again, does anyone know where the extra Huang Tingdan that Manager Jin got came from?"
I don't know if it was an illusion, but Jiang Li always felt that the immortal master's eyes fell near him intentionally or unintentionally, making him couldn't help but look up.
But when he saw Manager Jin's eyes also falling on him, Jiang Li was shocked.
He hurriedly lowered his head and pretended that nothing happened.
This matter must never be spoken out.
After waiting for a moment, the immortal master did not get the answer he wanted, so he snorted coldly: "Remember! Take at most one Huang Ting Dan every three days, otherwise you will be like him, with abnormal expansion of the qi orifices and endless bleeding."
"Carry him back and he will recover in seven days. This time can be regarded as a lesson to you."
After saying that, the immortal master jumped onto the crane and flew towards Piandu Peak.
After the immortal master left, the servant disciples relaxed.
Someone carried Steward Jin back to his room, and the rest of the handyman disciples also returned to their rooms.
As soon as Jiang Li returned to his house, there was a knock on the door.
When he opened the door, he saw a handyman disciple who was usually close to Manager Jin.
The handyman disciple looked Jiang Li up and down before he said, "Manager Jin wants to see you for something, please come over."
"Hey, okay."
Jiang Li had no choice but to go out again and came to Manager Jin's room.
As soon as he entered Manager Jin's room, Jiang Li smelled a strong smell of blood.
Steward Jin's body was covered with bandages, but blood was still seeping out of the bandages, which looked a little scary.
Seeing that Huang Tingdan, who had been occupied by Manager Jin, ended up in such an end, he couldn't help but feel happy in his heart.
You deserve it, you really deserve it.
This feels... cool!
Although he felt that Manager Jin deserved his punishment in his heart, he did not dare to show it on the surface.
He bowed to Steward Jin and asked, "Why did Steward Jin call me here to tell you something?"
Manager Jin wailed and waited for a long time, and then he had the strength to say: "You have worked hard these past two days. From now on, you don't need to do the work of chopping wood. I will arrange for others to do it. You clean up and report to the alchemy room tomorrow, and you will be responsible for cleaning the alchemy room."
"Alchemy room?"
Jiang Li was stunned.
